title: Euler Totient OQ-02-OQ-01: Factorization Product Formula
description: Records the Lean factorization/product-formula route for Euler's totient function using Mathlib's prime-factorization infrastructure.

problemStatement.formal: Derive totient product formulas from Nat.factorization and multiplicativity, including rational and divisor-product presentations.
problemStatement.plain: Formalizes the standard product formula for Euler's totient function by reducing it to the prime-power factorization of n.
whyMatters: It connects the computational totient API to the classical product over prime divisors.
The file provides concrete checked examples such as phi(12), phi(30), and phi(360).
The proof clarifies that the product formula is a consequence of factorization plus multiplicativity.

proven: `totient_factorization_formula` states the factorization-product version for nonzero n.
`totient_rational_formula` and `totient_div_primes_formula` expose rational and divisor-product forms.
`totient_from_multiplicativity` derives the formula from multiplicativity and prime powers.
`EulerTotientOQ02OQ01.lean` is recorded with 0 axioms and 0 sorries.
open: The file focuses on the factorization route, not on a separate analytic theory of average totient order.
knownResults.goal: Surface the completed totient product-formula formalization as a verified extension of multiplicativity.
